title: Netlify
description: Netlify publishes its palette in the official Netlify brand guide: teal 800 (#014847), teal 400 (#05bdba), teal 200 (#32e6e2), neutral 800 (#181a1c) and white (#ffffff), with accents blue 700 (#2e51ed), purple 800 (#382aa4), red 500 (#fe4e5c), gold 300 (#fbb13d), pink 700 (#9a2d99) and green 400 (#3ac364, UI only).
